results.title: NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription missing (Bluetooth detected)
results.description: The module requiring Bluetooth was detected but NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription is not declared.
results.fix: Add NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription under expo.ios.infoPlist in app.json with a clear description.

results.title: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION declared but location module not detected
results.description: The location permission requires a clear justification in the Data Safety Section.
results.fix: Remove if location is not used or add the corresponding module.
